item.title: [7.4] Bank of England hikes rates to 4%, first raise since 2023, says more may come amid high UK inflation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

In a decisive move, the Bank of England has escalated interest rates to 4% amidst spiraling inflation, projected to hit 4.8% in Q2 next year. Governor Andrew Bailey cautioned that further hikes may be necessary, especially with ongoing global conflicts. Market reactions were notably favorable, with the British pound gaining strength against the US dollar.

WHY IT MATTERS

Directly impacts monetary policy expectations, interest rate trajectories, and global asset pricing.

item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. item.title: [6.2] PATTS: Parallel-Aware Test-Time Scaling for Thought-Image Generation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion LLMs
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Test-time scaling (TTS) improves generative models by allocating additional inference-time computation to sampling, search, and verification. Existing image generation approaches, however, typically rank completed images or image-centric intermediate states. We study TTS for parallel multimodal discrete diffusion language models, in which reasoning tokens and image tokens are decoded jointly...

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper introduces a novel test-time scaling method (PATTS) for joint reasoning and image generation in multimodal discrete diffusion models, addressing a clear alignment limitation in current verifiers.
